title: scrophularia crithmifolia subsp. alpina
intro: Scrophularia crithmifolia subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Scrophularia, is a plant species belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various conditions such as digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Scrophularia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
